user_report.event: Windows Update forced a computer reboot; user restarted the computer, after which CAH was brought back into use
user_report.time_certainty: User estimate; originally described ~04:00, then corrected to about ~06:00; exact reboot/system uptime not independently checked
user_report.note: An OS restart is not proof of surviving mains-power loss, storage flush failure, or forced termination at an arbitrary write boundary

durable_git_before_reported_reboot.scope_caveat: At last verified pre-reboot checkpoint the parent was waiting for user input; there was no demonstrated interrupted in-flight Worker computation restored exactly where it stopped

observed_post_restart_chain.event: Start_CAH.ps1 reported successful CAH startup/health verification: existing Bridge, managed/short runners and reusable Playwright Host/CDP present
observed_post_restart_chain.caveat: Playwright Host was reused, not newly created in that run. The Action later failed in its additional Git FETCH_HEAD readback, not in Start_CAH startup; does not establish boot-to-service availability latency

observed_post_restart_chain.caveat: Generation change is normal Worker continuation, not independent proof of watchdog-triggered fault recovery

observed_post_restart_chain.event: Same logical Child generation 10 admitted on lane-00; no new parent task was required

measured_resume_intervals.caution: Intervals compare recorded checkpoint timestamps and do NOT measure actual Windows reboot duration or prove restart action caused the pre-existing Host to resume

observer_commentary.assessment: 这次出现可核验的跨重启持久化接续：同一任务的 Git 状态保留，恢复在线后 Planner 接收新用户意图，Worker 继续原 Child，并在真实 Runner 上推进 A6。画面 QA 仍未通过，不能算成片。
observer_commentary.architecture: 证明了 Git canonical 状态与任务身份、事件、代际接续的实际韧性；未证明停机瞬间在途计算可精确恢复，也不能把正常 G+1 说成 Watchdog/Helper Recovery，更不能等同于断电一致性测试。
observer_commentary.watch_next: 核验 S21/S23 字幕安全区域的修复和六场景正式验收；如做正式断电容错测试，应隔离模拟并证明在途写入原子性及恢复边界。
